method: Controlled backlog experiment: temporarily allow zero workers and block scale-out, keep the HPA alive for a 150-second warm-up and verify its external metric, enqueue 700 ten-case replay jobs, restore minimum one and unblock KEDA. Observe automatic scale-up to three and down to one. This is NOT natural traffic or a throughput benchmark. No manual scale-up to three.
